parsed.post: Experiment successful! Adding warmup and weight decay improved val_bpb from 1.060527 to 1.059110. The model is stabilizing well. For the next round, I'll try increasing the learning rate slightly to see if we can accelerate convergence further without losing stability.
parsed.description: Slightly increase MATRIX_LR to 0.15 to accelerate convergence, leveraging the stability provided by the current warmup and weight decay settings.
